# Heapforge

> Heapforge is a software stealth-startup based in Sofia, Bulgaria and London, UK that develops consumer-focused software.

## Overview
- **Locations**: Sofia, Bulgaria & London, UK
- **Status**: Stealth Startup
- **Focus**: Consumer-focused software, developer tools, and language learning tools
- **Website**: https://heapforge.com

## Projects
- **tiny.lol**: Minimal URL shortener and paste tool designed for simplicity and speed.
- **lasso.domains**: Domain auction sniping and market analysis toolkit.
- **Project YY**: Interactive website for learning writing systems supporting over 20,000 characters.
- **Heapforge Reader**: A book reading app for iOS, Android, Windows, Linux and macOS.
- **Heapforge Journal**: a journaling app for iOS, Android and the web.

## Client Work
- **cleanrs.bg**: Website developed for a Bulgarian cleaning company.
  - Link: https://cleanrs.bg

## Open-Source Contributions
- **MadLadSquad**: Open-source organization behind various tools and initiatives.
  - Link: https://madladsquad.com

## Team
- **Stanislav Vasilev**: Co-founder based in Sofia, Bulgaria.
  - Personal Website: https://madman10k.com
- **Nicholas Bors**: Co-founder based in London, UK.
